title: Launch of Collider
statementMd:
There will be a launch of a new, powerful and unusual collider very soon, which located along a straight line. $*n*$ particles will be launched inside it. All of them are located in a straight line and there can not be two or more particles located in the same point. The coordinates of the particles coincide with the distance in meters from the center of the collider, $*x*_{*i*}$ is the coordinate of the $*i*$-th particle and its position in the collider at the same time. All coordinates of particle positions are **even integers**.

You know the direction of each particle movement — it will move to the right or to the left after the collider's launch start. All particles begin to move simultaneously at the time of the collider's launch start. Each particle will move straight to the left or straight to the right with the constant speed of $1$ meter per microsecond. The collider is big enough so particles can not leave it in the foreseeable time.

Write the program which finds the moment of the first collision of any two particles of the collider. In other words, find the number of microseconds before the first moment when any two particles are at the same point.

## Input

The first line contains the positive integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of particles.

The second line contains $*n*$ symbols "`L`" and "`R`". If the $*i*$-th symbol equals "`L`", then the $*i*$-th particle will move to the left, otherwise the $*i*$-th symbol equals "`R`" and the $*i*$-th particle will move to the right.

The third line contains the sequence of pairwise distinct **even** integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the coordinates of particles in the order from the left to the right. It is guaranteed that the coordinates of particles are given in the increasing order.

## Output

In the first line print the only integer — the first moment (in microseconds) when two particles are at the same point and there will be an explosion.

Print the only integer `-1`, if the collision of particles doesn't happen.

## Note

In the first sample case the first explosion will happen in $1$ microsecond because the particles number $1$ and $2$ will simultaneously be at the same point with the coordinate $3$.

In the second sample case there will be no explosion because there are no particles which will simultaneously be at the same point.
statementZhMd:
很快将启动一个位于直线上的新型、强大而独特的碰撞器。碰撞器中将发射 $*n*$ 个粒子。所有粒子都位于同一直线上，并且任意两个或多个粒子不会位于同一点。粒子的坐标表示其到碰撞器中心的距离（单位：米），$*x*_{*i*}$ 是第 $*i*$ 个粒子的坐标，同时也是它在碰撞器中的位置。所有粒子位置的坐标都是**偶整数**。

你知道每个粒子的运动方向——碰撞器启动后，它将向左或向右移动。所有粒子在碰撞器启动的同一时刻开始运动。每个粒子将以每微秒 $1$ 米的恒定速度沿直线向左或向右移动。碰撞器足够大，因此在可预见的时间内粒子不会离开碰撞器。

请编写程序，求碰撞器中任意两个粒子第一次发生碰撞的时刻。换句话说，求在任意两个粒子第一次位于同一点之前经过的微秒数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个正整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$）——粒子的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个字符“`L`”和“`R`”。如果第 $*i*$ 个字符等于“`L`”，则第 $*i*$ 个粒子将向左移动；否则第 $*i*$ 个字符等于“`R`”，第 $*i*$ 个粒子将向右移动。

第三行包含由两两不同的**偶**整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ 组成的序列（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——按从左到右的顺序给出粒子的坐标。保证粒子的坐标按递增顺序给出。

## 输出格式

第一行输出唯一的整数——两个粒子位于同一点并发生爆炸的最早时刻（单位：微秒）。

如果粒子不会发生碰撞，则只输出整数 `-1`。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第一次爆炸将在 $1$ 微秒后发生，因为编号为 $1$ 和 $2$ 的粒子将同时位于坐标为 $3$ 的同一点。

在第二个样例中不会发生爆炸，因为不存在会同时位于同一点的粒子。
